# opnsense_haproxy_frontend (Resource)

Manages an OPNsense HAProxy frontend. TCP mode can be used for L4 TLS passthrough without terminating TLS on the firewall.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bind` (Set of String) Listen addresses in HAProxy address:port syntax.
- `name` (String) Unique HAProxy frontend name.

### Optional

- `bind_options` (String) Optional raw bind options.
- `custom_options` (String) Optional raw frontend directives, for example TCP inspection directives required before SNI routing.
- `default_backend` (String) UUID of the default backend.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable the frontend. Defaults to `true`.
- `linked_actions` (Set of String) HAProxy action UUIDs attached to the frontend.
- `mode` (String) Frontend mode: `http`, `ssl`, or `tcp`. Use `tcp` for raw TLS passthrough. Defaults to `http`.
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Whether HAProxy terminates TLS on this frontend. Keep disabled for L4 passthrough. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the HAProxy frontend.
